fileSystemTypedConstructorQualification.sharedTraversal: Existing IFileSystemEntryView and IFileSystemVolumeView already expose the common read-only operations
fileSystemTypedConstructorQualification.mapping: FileSystemVolumeMapper explicitly maps both entry enums and recreates analysis records; ConvertVolume and ToFileSystemsVolume adapt the public models
fileSystemTypedConstructorQualification.dependency: MediaEngine references MediaFileSystems; MediaFileSystems references MediaAnalysis and not MediaEngine
